scripts.dev: concurrently "uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3001 --reload --reload-dir apps/api/app" "npm run dev -w @maic/web"
scripts.build: uv run --project apps/api python -m compileall -q apps/api/app apps/api/tests && npm run build -w @maic/web
scripts.test: uv run --project apps/api python -m unittest discover -s apps/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: uv run --project apps/api python -m compileall -q apps/api/app apps/api/tests && npm run typecheck -w @maic/web
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
